response.sql: WITH status_tallies AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), with_totals AS (SELECT archstat, tally, SUM(tally) OVER () as total_tally, COUNT(*) OVER () as num_statuses FROM status_tallies), with_shares AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally::NUMERIC / total_tally as share, 1.0::NUMERIC / num_statuses as average_share FROM with_totals) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - average_share as above_average FROM with_shares WHERE share > average_share
